title: MCET 530 Thermal-Fluid Sciences II Open Textbook

pages.title: Entropy as a Thermodynamic Property
pages.description: Define entropy as a thermodynamic property, determine entropy changes between states, and interpret entropy in thermal-fluid systems.

pages.title: Entropy Generation and Irreversibility
pages.description: Relate entropy generation to irreversibility, reversible limits, and the increase of entropy principle.

pages.title: Entropy Balance for Control Volumes
pages.description: Apply entropy balances to steady and unsteady control volumes with heat transfer, mass flow, and entropy generation.

pages.title: Process Feasibility Using Entropy Generation
pages.description: Use entropy generation and entropy balances to classify processes as reversible, irreversible, or impossible.
